<!-- בדיקת ורטיקל · pure-downstream · 1 מספרים נושאי-קול · 1 ערוצי-יציאה -->
<include>
  <context name="tenant_v-chesed">

    <!-- שער-הזמן: ברירת-מחדל סגור, נפתח רק בחלון שעות-המשרד -->
    <extension name="office_default" continue="true">
      <condition>
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="office_open_window" continue="true">
      <condition wday="1-5" time-of-day="9:00-17:00">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=true"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>

    <!-- לוח-עברי: 10 ימי-חג → סגור (מחושב מ-2026-09-01, חלון 400 יום) -->
    <extension name="heb_20260912" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2026-09-12 00:00:00~2026-09-12 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=ראש השנה"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="heb_20260913" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2026-09-13 00:00:00~2026-09-13 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=ראש השנה"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="heb_20260921" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2026-09-21 00:00:00~2026-09-21 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=יום כיפור"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="heb_20260926" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2026-09-26 00:00:00~2026-09-26 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=סוכות"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="heb_20261003" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2026-10-03 00:00:00~2026-10-03 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=שמיני עצרת · שמחת תורה"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="heb_20270422" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2027-04-22 00:00:00~2027-04-22 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=פסח"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="heb_20270428" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2027-04-28 00:00:00~2027-04-28 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=שביעי של פסח"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="heb_20270611" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2027-06-11 00:00:00~2027-06-11 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=שבועות"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="heb_20271002" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2027-10-02 00:00:00~2027-10-02 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=ראש השנה"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="heb_20271003" continue="true">
      <condition date-time="2027-10-03 00:00:00~2027-10-03 23:59:59">
        <action application="set" data="office_open=false"/>
        <action application="set" data="closed_reason=ראש השנה"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>

    <!-- כניסה: כל מספר נושא-קול מזוהה לפי ה-DID ומנותב פנימה -->
    <extension name="in_n1">
      <condition field="destination_number" expression="^\+97221000000$">
        <action application="set" data="inbound_line=ראשי"/>
        <action application="set" data="inbound_number=+97221000000"/>
        <action application="transfer" data="incoming XML tenant_v-chesed"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>

    <!-- ניתוב: פתוח → משרד (אין-מענה נופל לאחרי-שעות); סגור → מנהל → תא-קולי -->
    <extension name="incoming">
      <condition field="destination_number" expression="^incoming$"/>
      <condition field="${office_open}" expression="^true$">
        <action application="bridge" data="{leg_timeout=25}user/101@v-chesed"/>
        <action application="transfer" data="afterhours XML tenant_v-chesed"/>
        <anti-action application="transfer" data="afterhours XML tenant_v-chesed"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <extension name="afterhours">
      <condition field="destination_number" expression="^afterhours$">
        <action application="bridge" data="{leg_timeout=30}user/201@v-chesed"/>
        <action application="answer"/>
        <action application="sleep" data="500"/>
        <action application="voicemail" data="default v-chesed 100"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>

    <!-- יציאה: קידומת <ערוץ>#<מספר> בוחרת דרך איזה SIM לצאת -->
    <extension name="out_pick_n1">
      <condition field="destination_number" expression="^1#(\+?\d+)$">
        <action application="set" data="effective_caller_id_number=+97221000000"/>
        <action application="set" data="effective_caller_id_name=ראשי"/>
        <action application="bridge" data="sofia/gateway/v-chesed-gw1/$1"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
    <!-- יציאת-ברירת-מחדל (חיוג רגיל בלי קידומת) → ראשי -->
    <extension name="out_default">
      <condition field="destination_number" expression="^(0\d{7,9}|\+?\d{8,15})$">
        <action application="set" data="effective_caller_id_number=+97221000000"/>
        <action application="bridge" data="sofia/gateway/v-chesed-gw1/$1"/>
      </condition>
    </extension>
  </context>
</include>
